Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 58: the slip of [[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on your non-[Maintenance] AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If just lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.”), word for word the text of [[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
